Definition: to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind)
BiblicalUsage: When the LORD blows with His wind, the sea covers the enemy, and the princes of the earth wither when He only breathes upon them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's wind needs no army behind it: one breath from Him drowns Pharaoh's host and withers the proud, and the sea does what no sword could do.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
